object.Title: The Resurrection and Other Scenes from Christ's Life
object.Description:
The Resurrection of Christ in the center of this icon is surrounded by images of the Annunciation, Nativity, Birth of the Virgin, Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple, Presentation of Christ in the Temple, Baptism, Transfiguration, Entry into Jerusalem, Holy Trinity, Pentecost, Dormition of the Virgin, and Ascension.

For the latest information about this object, The Resurrection and Other Scenes from Christ's Life, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Hammer Galleries, New York, by purchase; Walters Art Museum, 1952, by purchase.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/44.631
